settings.title: App Settings
settings.subtitle: Emergency callback number & app preferences
settings.callbackDescription: Dispatchers use this number to contact you during an emergency response. This number is dispatch-only, never shown publicly, and never linked to community reports.
settings.invalidPhoneWarning: This doesn't look like a valid number — save anyway?
settings.languageDescription: Select your preferred language for the AGAP interface.

home.quickActions: Help and information, one tap away.
home.noCachedLocation: No cached location available yet. Press "Refresh My Location" to save.
home.emergencyDescription: Press the button below to request immediate CDRRMO emergency response. Works offline and on degraded signals.

sos.title: Emergency Assistance
sos.description: Hold the button for 2 seconds to alert CDRRMO.
sos.activeDescription: CDRRMO has received your alert. Keep your phone near you.
sos.resolvedDescription: Your emergency request has been resolved. Stay safe.
sos.holdSosAria: Hold for 2 seconds to send an SOS request
sos.sentDetail: Stay where it is safe, if you can.
sos.queuedDetail: Keep AGAP open. It will send automatically.
sos.statusPendingDetail: Your request is received. We are assigning a rescue team.
sos.statusPendingStaleDetail: Waiting for team assignment. Keep your phone reachable and stay safe.
sos.statusRespondingDetail: A rescue team is assigned and is on their way to your location.
sos.statusResolvedDetail: Responders have completed this request. Stay safe.
sos.completeBody: Responders have marked this request as complete. Stay safe!
sos.channelsBody: If you have load balance, you can also call 911 directly or send a text.
sos.batteryTip: Put your phone in airplane mode between checks to save battery.
sos.osSosTip: Pressing your phone's power button 5 times calls emergency services directly.
sos.statusQueuedDetail: This request is saved on your phone and will send automatically when signal returns.
sos.truthBody: Your SOS is saved safely on your phone and will auto-send as soon as signal returns. Try calling 911 or texting below.
sos.truthRelay: If responders arrive, show them this code:
sos.expectationBody: Your request is received and monitored by emergency responders.They will do their best to tend to your needs.
sos.gateBody: This will send an emergency alert to CDRRMO. Dispatchers will see your request.
sos.gateAria: Confirmation required before sending an SOS
sos.updateSubtitle: Let responders know your latest situation.
sos.updateStillHereDetail: Confirm you are waiting at this spot
sos.guidanceTitle: What to do while you wait
sos.guidanceBody: Open safety guidance for your situation.
sos.rescueConfirmBody: Only confirm if you are safe or with responders, so teams can focus on others in danger.
sos.locationRequiredBody: We need your location to guide emergency responders to you.

communityReport.title: Community Incident Report
communityReport.anonymityDescription: We don't include any personal details on your report. Your privacy is guaranteed.
communityReport.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the incident (e.g. submerged road on creek bridge, fallen tree touching powerlines, clogged main canal)...
communityReport.captchaError: Incorrect answer. Please solve the math challenge to verify human submission.
communityReport.nagMessage: You submitted a community report less than 30 seconds ago. To prevent accidental duplicate reports, please verify your submission. Cooldown remaining: {seconds}s.

connectivity.degradedMsg: Your emergency details are saved safely. Any SOS request will automatically send as soon as possible.
connectivity.offlineMsg: No internet connection detected, please stay safe. Any SOS request will automatically send as soon as we are online.
